title: auto_accept threshold must be one of the reachable reliability ceilings
trigger: Setting or reviewing auto_accept.confidence_threshold (config default in src/store/paths.js, a project's .dd/config.json, or the audit UI slider at src/ui/public/index.html).
behavior_delta: Use only a reachable ceiling as the auto_accept confidence_threshold. Check any value against the reachable set computed by autoAcceptThresholdLevels() in src/engine/reliability.js -- the full cross of RELIABILITY_CAP x CAPTURE_ORIGIN_FACTOR: 0.45, 0.5, 0.63, 0.7, 0.765, 0.85, 0.855, 0.95. A value between two of these is a dead zone: no candidate's ceiling can ever land there, so the threshold silently behaves exactly like the next reachable value above it, while looking like a distinct, deliberate setting. Flag any off-ladder value and replace it with the nearest real ceiling that matches the intended policy, rather than leaving or introducing an arbitrary number.
what: Use only a reachable ceiling as the auto_accept confidence_threshold. Check any value against the reachable set computed by autoAcceptThresholdLevels() in src/engine/reliability.js -- the full cross of RELIABILITY_CAP x CAPTURE_ORIGIN_FACTOR: 0.45, 0.5, 0.63, 0.7, 0.765, 0.85, 0.855, 0.95. A value between two of these is a dead zone: no candidate's ceiling can ever land there, so the threshold silently behaves exactly like the next reachable value above it, while looking like a distinct, deliberate setting. Flag any off-ladder value and replace it with the nearest real ceiling that matches the intended policy, rather than leaving or introducing an arbitrary number.
why: DEFAULT_CONFIG.auto_accept.confidence_threshold in src/store/paths.js shipped as 0.8, which is not reachable by any source-reliability x capture-origin combination. It behaved identically to 0.85 (only user_explicit+filesystem or user_correction sources ever cleared it) but looked like a meaningfully different, lower bar. This produced a real debugging session (recorded in PENDIENTES.md item 0.2) where a model-initiated + verified-filesystem proposal was expected to auto-accept under a 0.8 threshold and never could, because its real ceiling (0.765) sits below the 0.8 dead zone. The UI itself already codes this distinction (src/ui/public/index.html:628 labels an off-ladder value 'Not one of the reachable ceilings'), confirming this is a recognized invariant of the auto-accept design, not a one-off assumption.
